places.raw_name: Fort Smith (July's cabin on the edge of town)
places.name: Fort Smith
places.note: At their dirt-floored cabin, July says he'll pursue Jake; Elmira insists he take Joe, secretly pregnant and plotting to leave herself.
places.location_hint: July's cabin sits on the town's edge among pines, about a mile from the river

places.name: Arkansas River
places.note: Nearly a mile from the cabin; Elmira notes boats go up it almost weekly and could carry her away.

places.name: Kansas
places.note: Elmira was stranded there young and knew Jake and Dee Boot there as friends.

places.name: Dodge City
places.note: Elmira worked there as a prostitute; Jake teased she'd turn respectable.

places.name: Abilene
places.note: Scene of Elmira's wild years with Dee, his prank pie on a madam, and a girl's grim death on icy stairs.

places.name: St. Joseph
places.note: Dee staked Elmira to a fresh start there; she met July watching the trial where he testified.
places.location_hint: St. Joseph, Missouri, on the Missouri River

places.name: Missouri
places.note: State where Elmira and July met during a trial.

groups.label: July's household
groups.hint: Elmira on a stump outside the cabin; July off on his nightly rounds in town
